MAJOR: the coverage threshold gate has silently never been enforced in this repo's history. Vitest skips coverage report generation entirely (zero output) whenever any test fails, unless coverage.reportOnFailure is set -- it wasn't, and this repo has had 4 pre-existing failing tests since before this programme (Finding 5), so the 80% threshold for src/core/src/adapters was configured but never actually checked. Set reportOnFailure: true (a real fix, in scope for this card) to make it actually run, which revealed src/core measures ~77-79% (below 80%) and src/adapters measures ~10-51% (severely below 80%, adapters/equation at 0%, adapters/file ~12%, adapters/pdf-edit ~15%). Left both thresholds at 80% per this card's forbidden clause (must not lower them to force a pass) rather than hiding the gap. pnpm run coverage cannot exit 0 right now for two independent pre-existing reasons: Finding 5's failing tests still set the process exit code non-zero even with reportOnFailure, and src/core/src/adapters genuinely don't meet 80%. src/components/**'s own new threshold (lines 40, statements/functions/branches 35, measured 2026-07-29) is correctly configured and passes in isolation. See tasks/DRIFT-REPORT.md Finding 12. Needs a human decision: fund real coverage work for src/adapters/src/core, or reset those thresholds to their real measured values (a scope change outside any single task's own diff).

MAJOR: runCurrentWriterExportPreflight() (writerExportPreflight.ts:83-93) always sources pageCount/sourceBytes from useSessionStore (the open-PDF session), never checking useWriterV2Store's documentMeta for blank-document mode. Result: blank Writer documents (created via the 'Blank Doc' button, by design with no PDF open) ALWAYS fail preflight with NO_PDF_OPEN and OBJECT_OUTSIDE_PAGE_RANGE errors, and the preflight dialog has no way to proceed past errors (only Cancel) -- meaning blank Writer documents can never be exported via the real UI today (project ZIP, and likely every other export routed through runWithWriterPreflight). Discovered while building P5-T02's Journey 2 e2e test; worked around it by anchoring the journey on an already-open PDF instead of a blank document (an equally real, arguably more common Writer V2 usage path) rather than fixing the out-of-scope preflight bug. See tasks/DRIFT-REPORT.md Finding 13. Needs its own scoped task to thread documentMeta.mode through the preflight input builder.
